tools.name: get_live_spot_prices
tools.description: Get live Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), Platinum (XPT), and Palladium (XPD) spot prices in USD per troy ounce, plus the real-time Gold-to-Silver Ratio (GSR).

tools.name: search_bullion_catalog
tools.description: Search and filter OunceScout's canonical gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion catalog (coins, bars, rounds) with lowest verified dealer prices and multi-dealer offer counts.

tools.name: compare_product_dealers
tools.description: Get full side-by-side dealer price quotes, shipping policies, payment basis, and in-stock status for a specific bullion product by slug or product ID.

tools.name: calculate_budget_stack
tools.description: Run the OunceScout Smart Budget Stack Calculator to find the optimal physical Gold & Silver bullion stack for a target USD budget at today's lowest live dealer prices.

tools.name: list_verified_dealers
tools.description: List OunceScout's verified US bullion dealers, directory statuses, and Featured Dealer (Agate Precious Metals).
